cards.name: Giant Germ
cards.effectParaphrase: When destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 500 damage to the opposing player/team, then optionally Special Summon any number of Giant Germs from the physical owner's Deck in face-up Attack Position.
cards.historicalEligibility: pre-2004-09-30 printing verified; admission review still required
